excerpt.zh: 星尘风暴对[this.GetName]的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
excerpt.en: The impact of a Stardust Storm on [this.GetName] has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

texts.zh: 星尘风暴对[this.GetName]的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
texts.en: The impact of a Stardust Storm on [this.GetName] has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

texts.zh:
[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]解决了[this.GetName]上的水培阻塞和用水短缺的问题。殖民地的水供应网络得到了升级，现在可以滤去星尘风暴所带来的复杂杂质。

这些对用水基础设施的改进还可以用来提升[Owner.GetName]上的灌溉作业。
texts.en:
The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have dealt with the hydroponic blockages and water shortages on [this.GetName]. The colony's water supply network has been improved and can now filter out complex impurities such as those introduced by the Stardust Storm.

These improvements to our water infrastructure can be repurposed to improve irrigation efforts across the [Owner.GetName].
